# Data dictionary

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_data_dictionary.py from the dbt YAML. Do not edit by hand. -->

Types are the logical types declared in the YAML; Snowflake and DuckDB spell some differently (`double` is `FLOAT` on Snowflake, `varchar` is `TEXT`). Intermediate models are documented in [`models/intermediate/_int__models.yml`](../models/intermediate/_int__models.yml) and in the dbt docs site (`make docs`).

## Staging

### `stg_sec__numeric_facts`

*view* · [`models/staging/sec/stg_sec__numeric_facts.sql`](../models/staging/sec/stg_sec__numeric_facts.sql)

One row per numeric XBRL fact, at the SEC's eight-column grain. Includes every filing, every tag (standard and custom), comparatives, segment rows and co-registrant rows. Downstream models decide what to keep.

| Column | Type | Description | Tests |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fact_key` | varchar | Hash of the eight grain columns (adsh, tag, version, ddate, qtrs, uom, segments, coreg), plus grain_ordinal for the rare second and later rows that share all eight. Its uniqueness test IS the grain test. | not_null, unique |
| `grain_ordinal` | bigint | 1 for almost every fact. 2, 3, ... for further rows sharing all eight SEC grain columns, which the SEC documents as impossible but publishes (17 pairs in one 2026q1 10-K: derivative contracts with identical typed-dimension text). Ordered by value, then footnote. | accepted_values |
| `filing_id` | varchar | Accession number of the filing that reported the fact. | not_null, relationships |
| `tag` | varchar | XBRL element name, e.g. NetIncomeLoss. | not_null |
| `tag_version` | varchar | Taxonomy version (e.g. us-gaap/2023), or the accession number for custom tags. |  |
| `period_end_date` | date | End date of the value, rounded by the SEC to the nearest month end. | not_null |
| `duration_quarters` | integer | Quarters the value covers. 0 = point in time (balance sheet), 1 = one quarter, 4 = one year; 2-3 = year to date. | not_null |
| `unit_of_measure` | varchar | Unit, e.g. USD or USD/shares. |  |
| `segments` | varchar | Axis/member dimensions. NULL means no breakdown (the consolidated figure). |  |
| `coregistrant` | varchar | Co-registrant or related entity. NULL means the consolidated registrant. |  |
| `is_consolidated` | boolean | True when the fact has neither segments nor a co-registrant. |  |
| `fact_value` | decimal(28,4) | Value as a decimal. NULL when the source value is empty (nil) or unparseable. |  |
| `fact_value_raw` | varchar | Value exactly as published, kept to diagnose parse failures. |  |
| `footnote` | varchar | Footnote text attached to the value, if any. |  |
| `source_quarter` | varchar | SEC data set quarter the row was loaded from. |  |
| `loaded_at` | timestamp | When the loader wrote the row. The incremental watermark for fct_financial_facts. |  |

### `stg_sec__submissions`

*view* · [`models/staging/sec/stg_sec__submissions.sql`](../models/staging/sec/stg_sec__submissions.sql)

One row per SEC submission (filing), renamed and typed. Includes every form type and every amendment; nothing is filtered here.

| Column | Type | Description | Tests |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filing_id` | varchar | SEC accession number (adsh). Natural key of a filing. | not_null, unique |

| `sic_code` | integer | Four-digit Standard Industrial Classification code as of the filing date. Nullable. |  |
| `business_country_code` | varchar | Country of the business address (ISO 3166-1). |  |
| `business_state_code` | varchar | State or province of the business address (US/CA only). |  |
| `business_city` | varchar | City of the business address. |  |
| `incorporation_country_code` | varchar | Country of incorporation. |  |
| `incorporation_state_code` | varchar | State or province of incorporation (US/CA only). |  |
| `former_company_name` | varchar | Most recent former name, if the registrant has changed its name. |  |
| `name_changed_date` | date | Date of the change from the former name. |  |
| `filer_status_code` | varchar | Filer status, e.g. 1-LAF (large accelerated) ... 5-SML (smaller reporting). |  |
| `is_well_known_seasoned_issuer` | boolean | True if the filer is a Well Known Seasoned Issuer. |  |
| `fiscal_year_end_mmdd` | varchar | Fiscal year end as MMDD, e.g. 1231 or 0630. |  |
| `form_type` | varchar | Submission type, e.g. 10-K, 10-Q, 10-K/A, 20-F. | not_null |
| `base_form_type` | varchar | Form type with any /A amendment suffix removed (10-K/A -> 10-K). |  |
| `is_amendment` | boolean | True if the form type ends in /A. |  |
| `period_end_date` | date | Balance sheet date of the reporting period (parsed from YYYYMMDD). Documented by the SEC as always present, but empty for a few registration statements (two F-1 filings in 2026q1). | not_null |
| `fiscal_year` | integer | Fiscal year focus as reported by the filer. |  |
| `fiscal_period` | varchar | Fiscal period focus (FY, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4). | accepted_values |
| `filed_date` | date | Date the filing was filed with the SEC. | dbt_utils.expression_is_true, not_null |
| `accepted_at` | timestamp | EDGAR acceptance timestamp (US Eastern time, no offset in the source). |  |
| `is_subsequently_amended` | boolean | SEC 'prevrpt' flag. True if the filing was amended before the data set's cut-off. |  |
| `has_detailed_tagging` | boolean | True if footnotes and schedules are tagged at the detailed level. |  |
| `xbrl_instance_name` | varchar | File name of the XBRL instance document. |  |
| `registrant_count` | integer | Number of CIKs included in the submission (co-registrants). |  |
| `additional_ciks` | varchar | Space-delimited CIKs of co-registrants, if any. |  |
| `source_quarter` | varchar | SEC data set quarter the row was loaded from, e.g. 2024q1. |  |
| `loaded_at` | timestamp | When the loader wrote the row. |  |
